content: The generated stories were evaluated using both automatic metrics and human ratings. The automatic evaluation was performed by computing the METEOR metric BIBREF5 on a public test set and a hidden test set. The former is a set of $1,938$ image sequences and stories taken from the test set of the VIST dataset BIBREF4 . The latter consists of new stories generated by humans from a subset of image sequences of the public test set.
